args.title: Fix duplicate detection for overlapping statements uploaded concurrently
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

Update the concurrent upload handling or shared seen set so that when two statements with overlapping days are uploaded in quick succession, the second upload correctly detects the overlapping transactions as duplicates against the active or concurrent state.
